en.explanation: As the bubble moves upwards, besides the buoyancy force (the cause of which is pressure difference), only the force of gravity and the force of viscosity will act.
en.comprehension: A small spherical monoatomic ideal gas bubble is trapped inside a liquid of density (see figure). Assume that the bubble does not exchange any heat with the liquid. The bubble contains n moles of gas. The temperature of the gas when the bubble is at the bottom is T, the height of the liquid is H and the atmospheric pressure is P (Neglect surface tension)
